googleDrive.title: Google Drive Backup
googleDrive.description: Automatically back up signed intake forms, agreements, waivers, and invoices to your own Google Drive.
googleDrive.backupsWillStart: Backups will start on the next signed form or invoice.
googleDrive.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect Google Drive? Future signed forms and invoices will not be backed up until you reconnect.
googleDrive.connectExplanation: Sign in with the Google account that should own the backup folder. We'll create a folder named "{{folder}}" in your My Drive and write signed forms and invoices there. We can only see and modify files we create — your other Drive content stays private.
googleDrive.backfillExplanation: Upload signed forms and invoices that pre-date this integration. Re-runnable; already-backed-up records are skipped.

infobip.title: Infobip SMS Configuration
infobip.description: Configure Infobip to send SMS and OTP verification codes to clients.
infobip.senderHelp: Alphanumeric sender IDs (e.g. "Lumiere") require pre-registration in some countries.
infobip.baseUrlHelp: Found in your Infobip portal under API settings (e.g. xxxxx.api.infobip.com).

steps.signUp: Sign up or log in at portal.infobip.com
steps.createKey: Go to API Keys and create a new key
steps.noteBaseUrl: Note your custom API base URL from the portal
steps.enterSender: Enter sender name (register alphanumeric senders if required)

quo.title: Quo SMS & Call Sync
quo.description: Send SMS campaigns and waivers through Quo, and sync inbound SMS replies and call records (with transcripts and summaries) into each client's history. Note: Quo's API cannot place outbound calls — it logs calls that happen through the Quo app.
quo.savedToastDescription: Your Quo settings have been saved successfully.
quo.saveFirstDescription: Please save your Quo configuration before testing.
quo.saveAndTestFirst: Save and test your Quo configuration before enabling history sync.
quo.historySyncDisabledDescription: Quo will no longer send inbound SMS and call events to this CRM.
quo.historySyncEnabledDescription: Inbound SMS replies and call records will now appear in each client's history.
quo.phoneNumberHelp: Must be a number owned by your Quo workspace, in E.164 format.
quo.userIdPlaceholder: US123abc — leave blank to send as the number owner
quo.primaryLabel: Make Quo the default SMS provider

steps.generateKey: In Quo → Workspace Settings → API, generate an API key
steps.enterKey: Enter the key and one of your Quo phone numbers above
steps.enableSync: Click Enable Call & SMS History Sync to log inbound replies and calls

lowSessions.title: Low-sessions renewal nudge
lowSessions.description: Email clients (and text them when an SMS provider is enabled) as soon as an active package drops to only a few treatments left, with a link to renew from the client portal. Saved with the configuration above.
